rawContent:
Tweet by @hsprafrique (Sam Ivere)
Author bio: Founder @hsprtech • Software Engineer • YouTuber • Marketer • #mufc
Text: This hits different.

I’ve been running multiple agents for months and still felt like I was drowning in threads, half-finished worktrees, and the constant “wait which one was doing what?” tax. T3 Code fixed that exact pain.

The ability to spin something up, keep it cleanly tracked, merge, and just let it disappear without mental residue is huge. I’m not generating dramatically more code either, I’m just shipping a lot more of what does get generated because I’m no longer losing track of everything.

The part about regaining brain space is real. Agents were supposed to free us up, but without a proper control surface they just created a new kind of cognitive debt. This tool finally pays that debt down.

And yeah… the fun is back. That might be the most important metric.
